prompt: What year did Dota 2 officially release?
explanation: Valve released Dota 2 on 9 July 2013 after a closed beta that began in 2011.

prompt: What year was the first The International?
explanation: TI1 ran at Gamescom in Cologne in August 2011, the public reveal of Dota 2.

prompt: What year did Dota 2 Reborn move the game to Source 2?
explanation: Reborn launched in 2015 and rebuilt the client on Source 2.

prompt: What year did patch 7.00 add talent trees?
explanation: 7.00 shipped on 12 December 2016 with talents, a new map, and Monkey King.

prompt: What year was The International 10 finally played?
explanation: COVID delayed TI10 from 2020. Team Spirit won it in Bucharest in 2021.

prompt: What year did OG win their first The International?
explanation: OG won TI8 in Vancouver in 2018 after coming through the open qualifiers.

prompt: What year was Techies added to Dota 2?
explanation: Techies arrived on 12 December 2014.

prompt: What year did Team Falcons win The International in Hamburg?
explanation: TI14 was The International 2025. Falcons beat Xtreme Gaming 3–2 in Hamburg.

prompt: What year did OG become the first back-to-back TI winners?
explanation: OG defended the Aegis at TI9 in Shanghai in 2019.

prompt: What year did Team Liquid win The International in Copenhagen?
explanation: TI13 was The International 2024 in Copenhagen. Liquid took their second Aegis.

prompt: Who won The International 2011 in Cologne?
explanation: Na'Vi beat EHOME 3–1 at Gamescom in Cologne.

prompt: Who won The International 2012 in Seattle?
explanation: iG beat Na'Vi 3–1. It was the first International in Seattle.

prompt: Who won The International 2013 in Seattle?
explanation: Alliance beat Na'Vi 3–2. Game 5 is still called The Play.

prompt: Who won The International 2014 in Seattle?
explanation: Newbee beat Vici Gaming 3–1.

prompt: Who won The International 2015 at KeyArena?
explanation: EG beat CDEC 3–1. SumaiL was 16.

prompt: Who won The International 2016 at KeyArena?
explanation: Wings beat Digital Chaos 3–1, then the roster split apart.

prompt: Who won The International 2017 at KeyArena?
explanation: Liquid swept Newbee 3–0.

prompt: Who won The International 2018 in Vancouver?
explanation: OG beat PSG.LGD 3–2 after starting in the open qualifiers.

prompt: Who won The International 2019 in Shanghai?
explanation: OG beat Liquid 3–1 and became the first back-to-back TI winners.

prompt: Who won The International 10 in Bucharest?
explanation: Spirit beat PSG.LGD 3–2 in an empty Arena Națională.

prompt: Who won The International 2022 in Singapore?
explanation: Tundra swept Secret 3–0 in Singapore.

prompt: Who won The International 2023 in Seattle?
explanation: Spirit swept Gaimin Gladiators 3–0 in Seattle.

prompt: Who won The International 2024 in Copenhagen?
explanation: Liquid swept Gaimin Gladiators 3–0 and took their second Aegis.

prompt: Who won The International 2025 in Hamburg?
explanation: Falcons beat Xtreme Gaming 3–2. Official Dota 2 news called them Grand Champions.

prompt: Where was the first The International held?
explanation: TI1 was at Gamescom in Cologne, Germany.

prompt: Which team first won The International two years in a row?
explanation: OG won TI8 and TI9. No other team has gone back-to-back.

prompt: Who created the original Defense of the Ancients Warcraft III map?
explanation: Eul made the first DotA map. Guinsoo and then IceFrog later took the design.

prompt: Put these TI winners in the order they first lifted the Aegis.
explanation: Na'Vi 2011 → Invictus Gaming 2012 → Alliance 2013 → Newbee 2014.

prompt: Put these TI winners in the order they first lifted the Aegis.
explanation: EG 2015 → Wings 2016 → Liquid 2017 → OG 2018.

prompt: Put these TI host cities in the order they first hosted.
explanation: Cologne 2011 → Seattle 2012 → Vancouver 2018 → Shanghai 2019.

prompt: Put these Dota milestones in the order they happened.
explanation: Warcraft III DotA → TI1 in 2011 → Dota 2 release in 2013 → Reborn in 2015.

prompt: What year did patch 7.33 New Frontiers rebuild the map?
explanation: 7.33 shipped on 20 April 2023. It expanded the map and added Twin Gates, Watchers, and Tormentors.

prompt: What year did patch 7.36 add facets and innate abilities?
explanation: 7.36 shipped on 22 May 2024. Every hero got an innate and a choice of facets.

prompt: What year did neutral items first drop from jungle creeps?
explanation: Neutral items arrived in the Outlanders update, patch 7.23, on 26 November 2019.

prompt: What year was Aghanim's Shard added?
explanation: Aghanim's Shard arrived in the Mistwoods update, patch 7.28, on 17 December 2020.

prompt: What year did bounty runes first spawn?
explanation: Patch 6.82 added bounty runes on 25 September 2014. Two runes then spawned in the river every two minutes.

prompt: What year was Underlord added to Dota 2?
explanation: Underlord shipped on 23 August 2016. He was the last Warcraft III DotA hero ported to Dota 2.

prompt: What year was the first Arcana released?
explanation: Lina's Fiery Soul of the Slayer, the first Arcana, went on sale on 7 March 2013.

prompt: What year was the first Diretide Halloween event?
explanation: The first Diretide ran from 30 October 2012, during the Dota 2 beta.

prompt: What year was the first Valve-sponsored Dota Major?
explanation: The Frankfurt Major, the first Valve Major, ran in November 2015. OG beat Team Secret.

prompt: Which hero was the last Warcraft III DotA hero ported to Dota 2?
explanation: Underlord, once Pit Lord, shipped on 23 August 2016. Monkey King was the first original Dota 2 hero after that.

prompt: Who was the first original hero made for Dota 2?
explanation: Monkey King shipped with patch 7.00 on 12 December 2016, after every Warcraft III DotA hero had been ported.

prompt: Patch 7.33 added which new hero attribute?
explanation: 7.33 added Universal heroes. They have no primary attribute and gain attack damage from all three stats.

prompt: Which event did players demand with ༼ つ ◕_◕ ༽つ?
explanation: Valve skipped Diretide in 2013. Players spammed ༼ つ ◕_◕ ༽つ GIVE DIRETIDE until Valve brought it back in November.

prompt: Who sold the DotA-Allstars.com domain to Riot Games?
explanation: Steve Mescon, known as Pendragon, ran dota-allstars.com. Selling the domain to Riot split the old DotA community. IceFrog then pointed players at playdota.com.

prompt: In original DotA, Scythe of Vyse carried whose name?
explanation: It was Guinsoo's Scythe of Vyse, a nod to Steve Feak. Dota 2 dropped the name after he left to help make League of Legends.

prompt: Which shop did patch 7.23 remove from the map?
explanation: 7.23, the Outlanders update, removed both side shops. Outposts took those spots, and every player got their own courier.

prompt: Put these systems in the order they were added.
explanation: Talent trees in 7.00 (2016), then neutral items in 7.23 (2019), then Aghanim's Shard in 7.28 (2020), then the New Frontiers map in 7.33 (2023).

prompt: Put these heroes in the order they were added to Dota 2.
explanation: Monkey King in December 2016, Pangolier in October 2017, Grimstroke in August 2018, Mars in March 2019.

prompt: Put these Valve Dota projects in the order they first launched.
explanation: Diretide in 2012, Artifact in November 2018, Dota Underlords early access in June 2019, Crownfall in April 2024.

prompt: What year was Phoenix added to Dota 2?
explanation: Phoenix shipped on 29 January 2014. Ability Draft was added in the same patch.

prompt: What year was Oracle added to Dota 2?
explanation: Oracle shipped on 12 February 2015, the same day as Winter Wyvern.

prompt: What year was Arc Warden added to Dota 2?
explanation: Arc Warden shipped with patch 6.86 on 16 December 2015.

prompt: What year did Dota 2 add Turbo mode?
explanation: Turbo shipped in patch 7.07, Dueling Fates, in 2017.

prompt: What year did Dota Plus launch?
explanation: Valve launched Dota Plus on 13 March 2018 as a monthly subscription.

prompt: What year did Valve release Artifact?
explanation: Artifact, Valve's Dota card game, shipped on Steam on 28 November 2018.

prompt: What year was Ability Draft added?
explanation: Ability Draft was added on 29 January 2014.

prompt: What year was the Siltbreaker campaign?
explanation: Siltbreaker ran from 8 June to 18 September 2017 as the TI7 Battle Pass co-op campaign.

prompt: What year did Aghanim's Labyrinth first run?
explanation: Aghanim's Labyrinth was the summer 2020 co-op event. It launched in July 2020.

prompt: What year was the Nemestice event?
explanation: Nemestice ran from 24 June to 17 August 2021.

prompt: What year did Crownfall begin?
explanation: Crownfall started on 18 April 2024. It ran into February 2025.

prompt: What year was Dawnbreaker added?
explanation: Dawnbreaker shipped on 9 April 2021 with patch 7.29.

prompt: What year was Primal Beast added?
explanation: Primal Beast shipped on 23 February 2022.

prompt: What year was Muerta added?
explanation: Muerta shipped on 6 March 2023.

prompt: What year was Ringmaster added?
explanation: Ringmaster shipped on 22 August 2024.

prompt: What year was Kez added?
explanation: Kez shipped with Crownfall Act IV on 7 November 2024.

prompt: What year did Valve hire IceFrog?
explanation: IceFrog announced the Valve job in October 2009. That hire became Dota 2.

prompt: What year was the first Interactive Compendium?
explanation: The first Interactive Compendium was for The International 2013. 25% of sales went to the prize pool.

prompt: What year did Valve first sell a Battle Pass?
explanation: The International 2016 Battle Pass was the first one sold under that name. Earlier years used Compendiums.

prompt: What year was the first Persona released?
explanation: Invoker Kid, Acolyte of the Lost Arts, was the first Persona. It was a TI9 Battle Pass reward in 2019.

prompt: What year was Hoodwink added?
explanation: Hoodwink shipped on 17 December 2020, the same Mistwoods day as Aghanim's Shard.

prompt: What year was the Dark Moon event?
explanation: Dark Moon ran from 26 January to 6 February 2017. Players defended Selemene's temple from waves.

prompt: What was Underlord called in Warcraft III DotA?
explanation: He was Pit Lord, Azgalor. Valve renamed him Underlord for Dota 2.

prompt: What was Io called in original DotA?
explanation: Io's DotA title was Guardian Wisp. Dota 2 first shortened it to Wisp, then to Io.

prompt: What replaced the side shops in patch 7.23?
explanation: 7.23 removed both side shops. Outposts sat on those tiles and could be captured.

prompt: Patch 7.33 added which portals in the map corners?
explanation: New Frontiers added Twin Gates in opposite corners so teams could jump across the map.

prompt: Patch 7.33 added which 20-minute mini-boss behind each offlane?
explanation: Tormentors spawn at 20:00 behind each offlane. The first team kill drops an Aghanim's Shard.

prompt: Which hero received the first Persona?
explanation: Acolyte of the Lost Arts, young Invoker, was the first Persona. It was a TI9 Battle Pass reward.

prompt: After leaving DotA, Guinsoo helped create which game?
explanation: Steve Feak joined Riot and applied DotA lessons to League of Legends.

prompt: Besides the Aegis, what extra consumable can Roshan drop?
explanation: Roshan can drop Cheese, a huge instant heal. Later kills can also drop Refresher Shard.

prompt: Who won the first Valve-sponsored Dota Major?
explanation: OG beat Team Secret at the Frankfurt Major in November 2015.

prompt: Which game mode did patch 7.07 add?
explanation: 7.07, Dueling Fates, added Turbo plus Dark Willow and Pangolier.

prompt: Patch 7.00 added which jungle building that healed nearby heroes?
explanation: 7.00 added Shrines with talents, the backpack, and Monkey King. 7.23 later removed them.

prompt: Which rune did patch 6.86 add?
explanation: 6.86 added the Arcane Rune on 16 December 2015. It cut cooldowns and mana cost.

prompt: Which pair of heroes shipped on the same day?
explanation: Oracle and Winter Wyvern both shipped on 12 February 2015.

prompt: Which event shipped with Kez?
explanation: Kez shipped with Crownfall Act IV on 7 November 2024.

prompt: Patch 7.33 added which riverside building?
explanation: New Frontiers put Lotus Pools on the river edges. They spawn Healing Lotuses.

prompt: Which company hired IceFrog in 2009?
explanation: Valve hired IceFrog in October 2009 to lead a standalone DotA sequel.

prompt: What kind of game is Dota Underlords?
explanation: Underlords is Valve's auto battler. Early access started in June 2019 after the Auto Chess arcade boom.

prompt: Patch 7.23 gave every player what at the start of the match?
explanation: Outlanders gave each player their own courier. The shared team courier was gone.

prompt: Which patch added Snapfire and Void Spirit?
explanation: Both Outlanders heroes shipped with patch 7.23 on 26 November 2019.

prompt: Which Battle Pass campaign was a four-player dungeon?
explanation: Siltbreaker was the 2017 four-player co-op dungeon on the TI7 Battle Pass.

prompt: Which event had players defend Selemene's temple from waves?
explanation: Dark Moon in early 2017 was a wave-defense event at Selemene's temple.

prompt: Which two heroes shipped with Dueling Fates?
explanation: Patch 7.07, Dueling Fates, added Dark Willow and Pangolier on 31 October 2017.

prompt: Put these events in the order they first ran.
explanation: Dark Moon in January 2017, Siltbreaker in June 2017, The Underhollow in 2018, Aghanim's Labyrinth in 2020.

prompt: Put these heroes in the order they were added.
explanation: Dawnbreaker in 2021, Primal Beast in 2022, Muerta in 2023, Ringmaster in 2024.

prompt: Put these in the order they first launched.
explanation: Ability Draft in 2014, Turbo in 2017, Dota Plus in March 2018, Artifact in November 2018.

prompt: Put these map systems in the order they were added.
explanation: Bounty runes in 2014, Arcane Rune in 2015, neutral items in 2019, Twin Gates in 2023.

prompt: Put these heroes in the order they were added.
explanation: Hoodwink in December 2020, Dawnbreaker in April 2021, Marci in October 2021, Primal Beast in February 2022.

prompt: Put these Valve Dota steps in the order they happened.
explanation: Valve hired IceFrog in 2009, released Dota 2 in 2013, launched Reborn in 2015, then Dota Plus in 2018.
